ASC privacy declarations and submitted-build data flows not inspected.
StoreKit implementation and purchase documentation exist; real product availability and submission association unknown.
Traced local report persistence and remote branch; moderation staffing remains unchecked in release checklist. No live UGC acceptance.

findings.title: Apple requires additional review information before completing review
findings.release_path: App Store Connect submission to App Review; reviewer requests completion of the App Review Information Notes field.
findings.trigger: The supplied Guideline 2.1 Information Needed notice requests six categories of information and resubmission.
findings.impact: Review cannot be completed until the requested evidence is supplied. The notice does not identify a specific crash, infringement or screenshot violation.

evidence.location: User-supplied App Review notice in this chat
evidence.detail: Requests physical-device recording, purpose/audience, access instructions, external services, regional behavior and applicable rights or regulated-industry documents. Original submission materials were not inspected.

rules.applicability: New apps must provide sufficient information and access for a complete review; the supplied notice makes these six requests specific to this submission.

remediation: Add all six responses to App Review Information > Notes, based on the actual submitted build.

Include an accessible physical-iPhone recording from launch through the main workflow, account access/deletion, report/block and any paid feature flows. Record device model, OS version, app version and build.
Explain no-password guest access if that is the actual shipped authentication flow; provide valid credentials for any flow that requires them.
Supply applicable asset permissions and licensing evidence, and accurately identify non-applicable regulated-industry requirements.
validation: Open the recording link without owner authentication and verify all required steps are visible.
Reproduce review instructions on the submitted build and compare Notes, screenshots, description and actual functionality.
findings.effort: S for documentation; physical-device evidence and any defects may increase scope.
uncertainty: No existing ASC Notes or attachments were supplied; cannot identify which requested items were previously omitted or inadequate.
Internal reviewer rationale beyond the notice is unknown.

findings.title: Submitted online-social claims may conflict with the disabled business backend
findings.release_path: Info.plist BibiBackendEnabled=false -> BackendConfiguration.isEnabled -> AppStore initialization sets online=nil -> local session, chat outbox and report persistence.
findings.trigger: Applies if the submitted binary retains this gate and its listing or review notes promise functional online social features.
findings.impact: Under those conditions, reviewers cannot complete genuine online authentication, message delivery or server-side report processing as advertised. Source behavior alone does not establish the submitted-binary state or the reason Apple sent this notice.

evidence.detail: Business-backend gate is false in current source.
Gate reads the bundled plist and defaults to false.
Online service initialization is gated; disabled path sets online=nil.
Local entry records agreement acceptance, not remote authentication.
Without online services, messages are stored in the local outbox; persistence does not prove delivery.
Reports use a remote operation only online; otherwise persisted locally.
Explicitly retains disabled gate pending release acceptance and external dependencies.

rules.applicability: Backend-dependent advertised functionality must be operational and accurately described; UGC safeguards must operate where UGC service is provided. A local-only product is not automatically prohibited.

remediation: Inspect the exact submitted artifact and listing before treating this conditional issue as confirmed.

If online functionality is part of the shipped product, complete the existing release checklist and genuine service acceptance before enabling the gate and uploading a replacement build. Do not simply flip the gate.
Make review notes and listing accurately describe the actual approved product scope; documentation cannot substitute for unfinished advertised functionality.
validation: Inspect the submitted build plist and its source/CI revision correspondence.
On physical iPhones, verify real cross-account content, message delivery, report handling and account deletion for features claimed online.
findings.owner: Release manager / iOS / backend / moderation operations
findings.effort: M-L if online cutover is required; depends on actual submitted scope.
uncertainty: Submitted binary, CI logs and listing not available.
No live backend or physical-device actions were executed.
Not asserted as the confirmed cause of the Apple notice.

validation_gaps.question: Which build and runtime scope were submitted?
validation_gaps.needed_evidence: Exact version/build, matching IPA or archive, CI revision, current ASC description, screenshots and Notes.

validation_gaps.question: Can the requested physical-device flow be reproduced?
validation_gaps.needed_evidence: Recording on a physical iPhone running the latest OS, starting with launch; device/build identification and actual QA results.

validation_gaps.question: Are paid features reviewable in the submitted app?
validation_gaps.needed_evidence: ASC product states, availability and association with this submission; physical-device Apple sandbox evidence and actual diamond uses. Local StoreKit fixtures are insufficient.

validation_gaps.question: Are regional statements and content rights accurate?
validation_gaps.needed_evidence: Actual distribution regions and differences; applicable licenses and attribution for submitted films, photographs, music and artwork.
